hero.title: Discover what you truly know.
hero.subtitle: MindMap doesn't summarize your material. It diagnoses it. Upload a document, answer a few honest questions, and see a real map of your mind.

1.title: Upload
1.body: Drop a PDF, slide deck, or document. We extract structure, not summaries.

2.title: Diagnose
2.body: A short, adaptive conversation probes what you know - and what you only think you know.

3.title: Map
3.body: See a calm visual map of your mind, and a personalized review timeline that adapts to you.

principles.title: Why MindMap feels different
principles.1: Diagnosis, not generation. We never write the answer for you.
principles.3: Honest by default. We trend mastery downward when warranted.
principles.4: Calm by design. No streaks, no shame, no urgency.

footer.madeWith: Built with care for curious minds.
